0022600004.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons with Miami hosting Minnesota, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Heat a 50% chance to win. Miami's Bam Adebayo (groin), Dru Smith (calf strain), and Giannis Antetokounmpo (rest) are all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery) and has Ayo Dosunmu listed as day-to-day with rest, also a game-time decision. The Heat lost the 2025-26 season series 0-2, most recently 122-94 in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026.
